content.overview: The Central Government may, after consultation with the Chief Justice of India, remove the President, Chairperson or a Member on the grounds the section lists, including insolvency, conviction for moral turpitude, incapacity, or abuse of position.

content.study: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 417 (Removal of Members). The Central Government may, after consultation with the Chief Justice of India, remove the President, Chairperson or a Member on the grounds the section lists, including insolvency, conviction for moral turpitude, incapacity, or abuse of position. Apply only the conditions, approvals, filings and penalties stated in the section. A rule made under the Act cannot contradict the section. Not a verified closure.
